title: Spatial Memory of Object Locations with Open-Loop Stimulation at Encoding
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial EEG recordings from epilepsy patients performing a spatial navigation memory task. Participants encoded object locations during guided navigation and later recalled them by self-navigating. Open-loop electrical stimulation was delivered to hippocampal and entorhinal electrodes during encoding on alternating, difficulty-matched trials, with no stimulation at retrieval.
methods_description: Each session comprised 50 trials (2 practice, 48 experimental). Each trial had two learning trials with guided navigation to an object, followed by one test trial with the object invisible. Half of the experimental trials were stimulated, with stimulation lasting 5 s during both associated learning trials. Stimulation was delivered to a single electrode at a time, and its parameters are recorded in the events files. Trial blocks were counterbalanced using reflected object and start positions. Recordings were made with Blackrock or Medtronic systems at multiple clinical sites.
